subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI messages can reach shared context but still not appear in Open WebUI visible chat history

question: Should OpenClaw core own syncing external Control UI turns into Open WebUI's visible chat history, and through which supported boundary?
rationale: The missing behavior is source-reproducible, but choosing direct Open WebUI DB writes, an API/plugin adapter, or documented non-support is a product and ownership decision around third-party persistence.

options.title: Design opt-in sync
options.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow Open WebUI sync contract with configuration, schema handling, tests, and live Open WebUI proof before implementation.

options.title: Route through plugin or adapter
options.body: Keep core lean by adding only any missing extension seam and let an Open WebUI-specific plugin or integration own the private persistence coupling.

options.title: Document unsupported co-editing
options.body: Declare that OpenClaw owns transcript/model context only for this workflow and document that Open WebUI visible history is not updated by Control UI sends.

recommendation.title: Design opt-in sync
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and define a narrow Open WebUI sync contract with configuration, schema handling, tests, and live Open WebUI proof before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway chat and Control UI session work makes this the best available owner for the product and storage-boundary decision.
